# HubbardGetDimension

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/HubbardModels` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/HubbardModels/HubbardGetDimension`

```text
HubbardGetDimension, version 0.01

Usage: HubbardGetDimension [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    -x, --nbr-sites : number of flux quanta (default value = 20)
    --conserve-sz : Sz is a good quantum number
    --total-spin : twice the total spin value (default value = 0)
    --fermion : use fermionic statistic instead of bosonic statistic
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    --gutzwiller : use the Gutzwiller projection

output options:
    --save-disk : save output on disk
    --output-file : use this file name instead of statistics_sphere_n_nbrparticles_q_nbrfluxquanta.dim

misc options:

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
